Solutions {
	flattening
		a / (a - b) = f
		a - (a / f) = b
		b / (1 - [1 / f]) = a

	resolve WGCCRE 2015 error
		round(weighmean([(bs+er),(bs-er)],[phi,(1/phi)]),2)*1000
	resolve Error (radius is already mean)
		round(weighmean([(bs+er),(bs−er)],[0.53125,0.46875]),2)×1000

	area
		(tau * a^2) - (((tau * i * a * b^2)/sqrt(a^2-b^2)) * arccos(a/b))
	radius w/ equal area
		sqrt(A / (2 * tau))
	radius w/ equal volume
		cbrt(a^2 * b)
	
	mean of radii 
		round(mean(AR,VR),2)
}
